data.one_liner: Material 3 Expressive button components for Flutter with spring motion and toggle groups.
data.what_it_does: Provides Material 3 Expressive button components in Flutter featuring spring-driven physics, shape morphing, toggle button groups, split buttons, and floating action buttons. It supports localized rebuilds using ValueNotifier patterns and decoration-based styling.
use_when: You want Material 3 Expressive design patterns in your Flutter app.
You need spring physics animations on button press, hover, and shape morphing without writing custom animation code.
You require complex button layouts like split buttons, toggle groups, or connected button groups.
avoid_when: Your project uses a Flutter SDK older than version 3.47.0.
You prefer standard built-ins or Cupertino widgets exclusively.
strengths: Faithful implementation of Material 3 Expressive design with spring physics.
Localized rebuilds ensure high performance on interactions like hover and press.
Rich collection of specialized button types (toggle buttons, split buttons, FAB menus).
weaknesses: Strict requirement on Flutter 3.47+ and the standalone material_ui package.
Breaking API changes across minor/major version bumps require careful migration.
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.47.0+ and adding material_ui to pubspec.yaml along with m3e_buttons.
